reasons._legacy: #1004: RAGModule.search publishes core_rag_searches_total / core_rag_search_duration_seconds, so memory/rag imports the core metrics registry at import time. memory -> core is the allowed direction (18 such edges were already frozen); deferring the import would hide the coupling from this gate without removing it, which is what the gate's own message warns about.
reasons.plugins/web_ui_module/api/routes_chat.py: ADR-007 C3.3: memory.write moved to core/memory_facts/write.py, so both doors write a turn's facts with the same filter and the same first-turn rule; routes_chat also reads an engine result through core.endpoints.chat_engines._common (extract_engine_text), which moved out of the plugin because the core's atomiser needs it too. plugins -> core is the allowed direction.

ADR-007 C3.0: MemoryHelper moved to core/memory_facts/, so the UI door resolves it through the core module (memory_facts.helper_for) instead of a plugin-level singleton. plugins -> core is the allowed direction; the two memory_helper.py -> core.* edges it replaces are gone.
